title: 初次见面
curriculumStatus: Beginner prototype; exact HSK mapping pending review

nodes.zh: 林阿姨正在泡茶。你想怎么打招呼？
nodes.pinyin: Lín āyí zhèngzài pào chá. Nǐ xiǎng zěnme dǎ zhāohu?
nodes.en: Auntie Lin is making tea. How would you greet her?
nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.hint: Try 你好 or the more polite 您好. You are starting the conversation.

nodes.zh: 你好呀！我姓林。你叫什么名字？
nodes.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo ya! Wǒ xìng Lín. Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
nodes.en: Hello there! My surname is Lin. What is your name?
nodes.speaker: lin
nodes.hint: Use 我叫 + your name. A name by itself also works. 呀 makes the greeting warm and casual.

nodes.zh: 欢迎你！你是来旅游的吗？
nodes.pinyin: Huānyíng nǐ! Nǐ shì lái lǚyóu de ma?
nodes.en: Welcome! Are you here on vacation?
nodes.speaker: lin
nodes.hint: You can say 对 (that's right), 是的 (yes), or 我是来看朋友的 (I am visiting friends). This vacation phrase is enrichment.

nodes.pinyin: Mànman guàng, yǒu kòng lái hē chá!
nodes.en: Enjoy looking around. Come have tea when you have time!
nodes.speaker: lin
nodes.hint: A friendly 谢谢 or 好啊 is enough. 慢慢逛 is a relaxed way to say 'enjoy looking around'.
